notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.notes:
I would like to congratulate everyone happy holidays and happy new year hoping that you will continue to enjoy the game as I did by updating it in the next year :D
In this patch the biggest new is a better performance and optimization both in desktop and VR because after a lot of effort I found the means to improve it notably.
Also you can find among other things a function that adds in beta way and only in the new track of the room with which the objects are transparent when you can't see them from the camera that you are located and it works even in VR. I hope someone will give suggestions on whether or not to add it to the other tracks for immersion purposes.

Here are some of the improvements and new content in this update:
-New "Endurance" vehicle.
-New Saloon track decorated in Christmas style to celebrate the holidays :D
-New song "Jingle Bells Remix" created by our musician Angel the Curious
-New leaderboards for the new track in Race and Drift modes
-Reparated the failure to unlock the kitchen track (thanks to the user Strider1979 for warning us)
-Improved the performance and optimization of the game notably on all tracks.
-New function in beta phase by which the buildings are transparent if the car is not seen by the camera being used (Only in the lounge track)
